# Avocado device identity and metadata.
# This environment is stored on a dedicated FAT partition and accessed
# via fw_printenv/fw_setenv (libubootenv). U-Boot is not used as a
# bootloader on tryboot targets — the EEPROM loads the kernel directly.
#
# Boot slot is detected from the kernel cmdline (root=PARTLABEL=rootfs-{a,b}),
# not from this environment. Device identity vars (device_id, device_cert,
# device_key) are set by the provisioning script at flash time.

machine=avocado-raspberrypi5
